text: C106MG is a thyristor ( = SCR ), not a transistor. Working in direct current, it latches in the ON position until the current  is interrupted. An electromagnetic buzzer indeed would interrupt the current at every oscillation. The buzzer used in the video is an electronic one and it absorbs current continuously, thus it remains ON until the reset button is pressed .
